infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vaani requires camera access to scan student QR codes, library barcodes, and upload homework.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vaani requires GPS access for live bus telematics and teacher geofenced attendance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vaani uses background location to broadcast live bus tracking for school routes.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Vaani uses Face ID / Touch ID to securely protect your institutional ERP session.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Vaani to access your camera for QR scanning.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Vaani to use your location for live bus telematics & attendance.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Vaani to use biometric authentication.
